findings.description: F-019: `spisok_kadrov = pygame.image.load("assets/hodba.png").convert_alpha()` (build_chapter_20.py:1850) named a single Surface 'list of frames'. The object is one sheet that frames are sliced *out* of on the next lines, so the name actively misled.
findings.resolution: Fixed in scripts/build_chapter_20.py: renamed to `sprajt_list`, matching the section's own term «спрайт-лист». Both the load line and the subsurface() call inside poluchit_kadr() were updated. Verified after rebuild: `spisok_kadrov` returns 0 files and `sprajt_list` returns 1.

findings.description: S-010: in scripts/generate_chapter_20_outputs.py:280, `noga_sdvig = (i % 4) * 6 - 9` moves the leg monotonically -9 -> -3 -> +3 -> +9 and then snaps back on wrap, so the strip is a slide rather than a walk cycle. The alt text said «нога смещается влево-вправо», describing a ping-pong the frames do not perform.
findings.resolution: Alt text corrected in scripts/build_chapter_20.py to describe what the shipped strip actually shows — «нога от кадра к кадру смещается вправо, отмеряя шаг». The underlying frame sequence lives in scripts/generate_chapter_20_outputs.py, which is outside this batch's permitted file set, so the optional (-9, 0, +9, 0) ping-pong sequence is left for whoever owns that generator; the text/image mismatch itself is resolved.

evidence.summary: Learning objective and scope: Teaches sprite-sheet frame extraction with `subsurface()` and an accumulator-based animation timer decoupled from the game frame rate.

`subsurface((x, 0, w, h))` extracts one frame from a sheet Surface. -- Confirmed -- on a 128x32 sheet, frames 0-3 each return a 32x32 Surface; frame 4 raises `ValueError: subsurface rectangle outside surface area`.

`while vremya_animacii >= INTERVAL_KADRA` must be a `while`, not an `if`, so a long frame advances the animation the correct number of times and keeps the remainder. -- Confirmed -- the reasoning is correct and the notebook's 60-frame run keeps every frame index within range(KOLICHESTVO_KADROV) while changing more than once.
`% KOLICHESTVO_KADROV` cycles the frame counter back to zero. -- Confirmed -- standard modulo cycling, verified in the notebook's assert.
Advancing the animation after drawing makes it lag one frame behind. -- Confirmed -- consistent with 20.14's Update-before-Render rule, correctly cross-referenced in both directions.
